parsed.explanation: Combined national and state regime imposes birth-sex definition for documents, entry and facilities, with discrepancy-based refusal and possible fraud investigation, birth-sex custody with documented sexual assault and dismissed claims, and hormone-removal in national custody. Functioning courts have blocked some orders and national hate-crime, housing and employment protections exist, and execution/imprisonment for mere presence is not documented, but tier-1 facility and custody exposures follow the outed visitor with no reliably working remedy.

entry_documents.exposure: X passports stopped Feb 2025; new passports M/F per supporting documents, existing X valid to expiry. Supreme Court allowed restrictions Nov 2025. Reports of confiscation/blocking leaving travellers stranded. Visa cable: discrepancy/doubt requires refusal; suspected wilful misrepresentation may support permanent fraud ineligibility, not automatic.
entry_documents.protection: ACLU passport litigation, other orders blocked/enjoined, legal-aid FAQ on documents. Existing X passports remain valid until expiration.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy can trigger refusal, investigation/fraud allegation, detention and birth-sex placement, compounding entry exposure.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections bureau from 2026 adopted model including short hair, hormone removal, psychiatric substitution. Immigration custody reports: forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse of trans men. State case: trans woman housed by birth sex, celled with convicted sex offender, assaulted; court dismissed failure-to-protect/treatment claims.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Courts hear challenges; one bathroom arrest elsewhere resulted in pretrial release after 24 hours in men's ward. No documented working remedy in state prison case.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Arrest for facilities, immigration or documentation issues leads to birth-sex ward/cell and possible care denial.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National order bars trans people from government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. State 2023 order defines sex at birth and backs single-sex bathrooms/changing rooms. Nationally 9+1 jurisdictions ban all government buildings, others partial; 4 criminalise in certain circumstances.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 states plus DC have no ban in mapped categories; trespass example requires wilful entry plus refusal to depart, with exemptions; one city has public-accommodations protection since 2012.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: National birth-sex definition plus state endorsement makes facility use a continuous universal exposure; state enforcement provision for this state is not documented.

care_services.exposure: State bans gender-affirming care under 19, upheld 6-1 July 2024; visitor under 19 cannot obtain it, nor can visitor obtain it for minor in care. National custody hormone removal documented; proposed national insurance bar for under 18.
care_services.protection: Some national orders blocked/enjoined; no state adult care ban documented. Not documented.
care_services.interaction: Minor traveller adds care denial; adult emergency/hospital ward placement by document sex is not documented for this state.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Official birth-sex definitions, ban on trans athletes entering for women's sports, DOJ reward guidance using 'radical gender ideology', May 2026 counterterrorism strategy prioritising 'radically pro-transgender' groups, and national order directing investigation/prosecution over school social transition including pronouns.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Several orders blocked/enjoined; counterterrorism strategy states powers will not target mere disagreement; marriage and national employment protections remain.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat-framing by national agencies interacts with state facility/school enforcement and increases outing/investigation probability.

minors_guardians.exposure: June 2025 state sports ban signed, ten athletes identified affected; school association requires HRT/surgery evidence. Under-19 care ban applies to visiting minors and guardians. National school investigation/prosecution directive documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian travelling with minor faces care, school and sports exclusion even if adult visitor only faces facilities/documents.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No state-level trans violence statistics sourced, so street violence rate is not documented. State 1997 hate-crime law does not address gender identity. Poll found 66% support assigned sex on documents, an attitude signal not a violence rate.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crimes law covers gender identity since 2009; national housing/employment enforcement includes gender identity; one city ordinance since 2012, another repealed 2022.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: National recourse may operate where state law is silent, but prison case shows court dismissal limits remedy.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport and executive-order litigation unresolved; operative position must be checked before travel. Inventory does not record state bathroom enforcement, current local marker practice after 2023 order, or trans violence statistics.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Civil-liberties suit, injunctions/enjoinments of several orders, legal-aid guidance, municipal protections in one city.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Uncertainty about which national measures are in effect multiplies entry, facility and care exposure.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar worst feature: birth-sex prison housing with assaults and solitary/protective failure, courts recognising safety in principle but remedy slow or denied. Our case also adds entry fraud risk and national hormone-removal custody, but adds US litigation/injunctions and national hate-crime/housing protections, so not below 0.25.

Similar: repeated stops, invasive questioning, discretionary fines/detention without usual imprisonment, courts deferring to authorities. Our case is comparable or slightly lower because documented sexual assault in birth-sex custody and possible permanent visa ineligibility are more severe than hours-long detention.

Higher than this anchor: there, secondary screening causes delay and possible administrative refusal with slow appeal. Here screening is tied to mandated birth-sex documents, facility exclusion, birth-sex custody harm and threat-framing, making consequences follow every encounter rather than occasional delay.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller encounters one system: national birth-sex documents and visa scrutiny at entry, state/national facility segregation during stay, and birth-sex custody if detained, with care and school bans for minors. Protections are real but partial and litigated—national hate-crime, housing and employment law, city ordinances, injunctions—yet the documented prison dismissal and custody practices show remedies do not reliably prevent tier-1 exposures. No execution or routine imprisonment for presence is documented, keeping the score above severe-risk anchors, while universal facility/document/custody exposure keeps it well below reduced-risk anchors.
